existing_behavior_probe.source:
package main
import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "github.com/inxups/style-cli/core/state"
)
func main() {
 root, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "style-m3-d4-baseline-"); must(err); defer os.RemoveAll(root)
 s, err := state.New(filepath.Join(root,"state")); must(err)
 _, scope, err := s.Update("session", "main", state.EventUpdate{Source:"startup"}); must(err)
 cases:=map[string]any{}
 claim:=state.ClaimInput{Scope:scope, Repeat:"session", Action:"inject", Event:"session.start", Rule:"p/r", Body:"same",ReinjectOnCompact:true}
 res, allowed, err:=s.Claim(claim); must(err); check(allowed,"first claim")
 claim.Event="prompt.submitted"
 _, allowed, err=s.Claim(claim); must(err); check(!allowed,"shared point key")
 cases["shared_rule_claim_across_points"]=true
 must(res.Release()); _, allowed, err=s.Claim(claim); must(err); check(allowed,"released claim")
 cases["released_claim_retry"]=true
 _, scope, err=s.Update("session","main",state.EventUpdate{PromptSubmitted:true}); must(err)
 _, scope, err=s.Update("session","main",state.EventUpdate{PromptSubmitted:true}); must(err)
 check(scope.PromptCount==2,"callback counter")
 cases["two_prompt_callbacks_increment_twice"]=scope.PromptCount
 _, compact, err:=s.Update("session","main",state.EventUpdate{Source:"compact"}); must(err)
 check(compact.Epoch==1 && compact.PromptCount==2,"compact")
 claim.Scope=compact; _, allowed, err=s.Claim(claim); must(err); check(allowed,"compact claim")
 cases["compact_epoch_and_prompt_count"]=[]uint64{compact.Epoch,compact.PromptCount}
 _, resume, err:=s.Update("session","main",state.EventUpdate{Source:"resume"}); must(err)
 check(resume.Generation==compact.Generation && resume.Epoch==compact.Epoch && resume.PromptCount==compact.PromptCount,"resume")
 cases["resume_preserves_scope"]=true
 _, clear, err:=s.Update("session","main",state.EventUpdate{Source:"clear"}); must(err)
 check(clear.Generation==1 && clear.PromptCount==2,"clear")
 claim.Scope=clear; _, allowed, err=s.Claim(claim); must(err); check(allowed,"clear claim")
 cases["clear_changes_generation_without_resetting_prompt_count"]=true
 claim.Scope=scope; claim.Body="different"; _, allowed, err=s.Claim(claim); must(err); check(allowed,"new body")
 cases["new_body_hash_claims_immediately"]=true
 _, child, err:=s.Update("session","child",state.EventUpdate{}); must(err)
 claim.Scope=child; _, allowed, err=s.Claim(claim); must(err); check(allowed,"child")
 cases["child_scope_is_independent"]=true
 check(len(cases)==8,"case count")
 data,err:=json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"format":1,"kind":"existing_behavior_only","cases":cases},"","  "); must(err)
 fmt.Println(string(data))
}
func must(e error){if e!=nil{panic(e)}}
func check(ok bool,label string){if !ok{panic(label)}}
